text:
deploy-bot: Alert: Canary rollout v12 -> p99 latency spike detected in eu-west-1. SLO breach (5m window). p95=420ms, p99=1.9s, streaming stall-rate +4.2% in last 10m. Canary traffic: 15% -> started at 2026-03-15T06:40Z. Auto-notify oncall.

maria_oncall: Acknowledge. Paging now. I'm on it, will coordinate rollback if needed. @alex_runtime can you grab runtime traces?

alex_runtime: Looking. Initial quick checks: KV cache hits dropped ~70% for canary pods. There are increased memory spikes on GPU processes and longer seq lengths in telemetry (median seq len +40%). Hypothesis: model v12 uses longer context + different kv layout -> cache thrash + kernel fallback causing tail latency.

kyle_platform: I'm pulling canary logs: `redwoodctl rollout status canary-v12 --region=eu-west-1` shows 3/20 canary hosts reporting high queue depth. Sample logs: ```2026-03-15T06:47:12Z runtime WARN muxer queue depth=128 target=32```. Also seeing grpc stream timeouts on multiplexed clients.

alex_runtime: Repro snippet for local run (if helpful): ```python
# run quick load reproducer
from redwood import client
c = client.connect(region='eu-west-1')
for i in range(200):
  c.generate(model='rw-v12', prompt='short', max_tokens=256)
``` Seeing stalls after ~60 concurrent streams.

nora_support: Customer impact: Support queue shows increased complaints from AcmeCorp and EduFlow in EU between 06:45-07:05. Symptoms: slow responses, intermittent partial streams. No error 5xx spike yet, mostly timeouts/slow. Notifying CS contacts.

sanjay_product: Can we throttle canary traffic down to 5% and enable fallback to v11 for streaming while we triage? Need to limit blast radius.

maria_oncall: Agreed. Plan: 1) throttle canary 15% -> 5% 2) if p99 doesn't improve in 5m, rollback canary to v11 3) open a postmortem ticket. Executing throttle now.

kyle_platform: Executed: `redwoodctl rollout adjust --canary canary-v12 --set-weight=5 --region=eu-west-1`. Confirmed new weight: 5%. Observability note: dashboards updating.

ops-bot: Action log: throttle applied by kyle_platform at 2026-03-15T06:53:40Z.

alex_runtime: After throttle, p99 dropped from 1.9s -> 820ms in ~3m. Streaming stall-rate down to 1.1%. KV cache hit-rate improving but still below baseline. Need deeper heap/gpu-profile to confirm root cause.

nora_support: CS update sent to affected customers: short note explaining we're rolling back/throttling and monitoring. No escalation to enterprise SLAs yet but watching.

sanjay_product: If we can get stable metrics at 5% we can continue canary after patch; avoid full rollback unless necessary. What's ETA for runtime fix?

alex_runtime: I can try a quick mitigation: limit per-host concurrent streams to 8 and bump batching timeout to 10ms to avoid kernel fallback. Command: `kubectl patch deployment serving-runtime -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"concurrency-limit":"8"}}}}}'` and edit configmap `runtime-batching.timeoutMs=10`. Will test on canary hosts.

kyle_platform: Applying concurrency cap to canary subset now. Patch applied to nodepool-canary-eu.ops.

alex_runtime: Early results: p99->520ms, stalls ~0.4%. KV misses still slightly elevated but stable. Looks like backpressure + smaller batches helped. Will instrument deeper traces and file a kernel-selection bug.

maria_oncall: Good. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. Handing overnight monitoring to kyle_platform in case we need rollback later. Documentation: incident created #INC-2026-089 in ops.

ops-bot: Incident #INC-2026-089 created by maria_oncall at 2026-03-15T07:02:10Z.

nora_support: CS follow-up queued: status update to customers in 15m, include mitigation steps and ETA for root-cause analysis.

sanjay_product: Logging decision: no immediate full rollback. Continue reduced canary + fixes. Postmortem owners: alex_runtime (lead) + kyle_platform (infra) + nora_support (customer comms).

maria_oncall: Handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. @kyle_platform take primary oncall for live mitigation. If p99 > 1s again, escalate to oncall manager and consider rollback. :thumbsup:

kyle_platform: Taking over. Monitoring dashboards + traces open. Will escalate if regression seen.

(End of thread)
